definitionZh: 洪水彩色 CSS 属性定义了当前过滤器原始分区的颜色和其中的元素。 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.
sourceDefinition: The flood-color CSS property defines the color of the current filter primitive subregion in and elements within a . If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
